сильний вітер, реагенти є.довідка:
ABOUT. Lyusterko is a stylist in the browser. From her colours (skin, hair and eyes, read from her portrait), four girths (shoulders, bust, waist, hips) with her height, and her case (where she is going), the code picks four outfits from a catalogue of Ukrainian shops, checks them against style rules and shows them with photos and prices; she judges each one, and her verdicts stay on her phone. Everything personal (photos, measurements, colours, cases, outfits, verdicts) is kept in this phone's browser; a model receives only what it needs for one answer.

NAVIGATION. Four tabs at the bottom: «Сценарій» (the main screen: the chat with the stylist and the case card), «Образи» (the latest outfits; from there «Усі образи ›» opens the outfit library and the verdict log; before any outfits exist the tab leads straight to the library), «Оцінити» (photos of what she is wearing now → a verdict on her own outfit) and «Профіль». The current tab is marked with two gold dots. The chat field: on an empty case it is a large sheet in the middle of the screen; once the chat has started, a window above the tabs; on other screens it is folded into a pill with the last answer, and a tap unfolds it. During onboarding and while outfits are being built there are no tabs; onboarding has «Назад» and «Далі» at the bottom. The word «люстерко» at the top also leads to the main screen, and the circle on the right of the header switches between day and night on every screen. On a laptop (a wide screen) the same four sections form a rail on the left together with «Новий сценарій», «Збережені» and the list of saved cases; the chat field sits under the chat and the case card to the right of it (on the profile, the photos are on the right). Edits are made in a sheet that rises from the bottom: it has «Готово», and a tap on the dimmed background closes it.

ONBOARDING — three steps, once, while there is no profile yet. Step 1 «Про тебе»: the portrait (as soon as it is added, the skin, hair and eye colours are read automatically; «Зчитати кольори з портрета» reads them again; «Інший шлях — через будь-який чат-помічник» lets her copy the request into any chat assistant and paste its answer back), a full-length photo (needed only to try an outfit on her), a name or pseudonym (the profile is called by it in the list of people and in the verdict record) and consent to record shades together with verdicts. Step 2 «Що тобі до лиця»: three pairs of fields next to her face — gold or silver, pure white or milky white, warm or cool neutrals («не бачу різниці» is a full answer) — and whether her own colouring is bright or muted. These answers narrow the temperature of the palette when the photo cannot establish it; the step can be skipped and done later. Step 3 «Фігура»: shoulders, bust, waist and hips in cm at the widest point over underwear, and height; the code derives the figure type from them. «Готово» creates the profile and opens the case screen.

PROFILE (tab) — rows, each showing what is already there: «Фото» (portrait and full length), «Твої кольори» (three swatches: skin, hair, eyes), «Ім'я» (and consent), «Що тобі до лиця» (her answers), «Обхвати і зріст» (four numbers and height), «Розширені виміри» (all optional: high hip, knee, calf and ankle refine the fit on the legs and hips; foot length in mm and head girth in cm check shoe and hat sizes), «Люди на цьому телефоні» («Чий це профіль» switches between people and «Новий профіль» adds one: several people can use one phone, each with her own data). A tap on a row opens its editor as a sheet with the same fields as in onboarding. What is still missing for building is labelled in gold.

CASE — the main screen; the one main thing on it is the chat. Before the chat starts, under the question «Куди ти збираєшся?» there is a letter sheet: she writes into it, as to a friend, where she is going, when, what the weather is, what she wants and does not want; below it are three example beads (a tap puts the example into the field without sending it) and «Або заповнити рукою» (shows an empty case card). From her words the stylist builds the case passport: event, occasion, place, formality, part of day, temperature, precipitation, requirements and limits. The messages form a thread, and under the last answer lies the case card with rows: «Нагода» («Спорт, активність», «Подорож», «Звичайний день», «Побачення», «Театр, концерт», «Робота», «Свято, вечірка»), «Де» («Вдома», «Надворі», «У дорозі», «Заклад», «Зал», «Офіс», «Урочистий зал»), «Ошатність» (the step of dress for this outing — home, everyday, neat, smart, strict, evening dress or ceremonial — set by whose standard holds there and the evening, not the event's name; a dress code chosen by hand overrides it), «Коли й погода» (part of day, temperature, «Без опадів», «Можливий дощ», «Дощ», «Сніг», wind, de-icing chemicals on the roads), «Макіяж» («Нюд, непомітний», «Помітний», «Яскравий, виразний»; for the last two also a lip colour — noticeable makeup gives the outfit one more step of contrast near the face, bold makeup already holds the focus on the face; «хай обере стилістка» hands this decision to the code on purpose; the lip colour is chosen from a ladder of shades split into those recommended for her and the rest, each with its reason, next to «свій відтінок» and «хай обере стилістка» for the colour itself), «Прикраси» («Золото», «Срібло», «Перли», «Етно: дерево, кістка, бісер», «Без прикрас» or «хай обере стилістка»: the code matches gold and silver against the metal of the items and removes the opposite metal from the pick, no jewellery removes jewellery altogether, and pearls cannot be told from ethnic pieces because shops do not say so — the code says this in its report), «Не хочу» («глибоке декольте», «відкрита спина», «відкриті руки», «відкриті плечі», «відкриті ноги», «відкритий живіт» — a hard limit, not a wish: the code removes such items from the pick itself; limits the stylist heard in her words go here too — items, fabrics, prints, colours: the card row names only what the code actually holds, which is colours and what she refused in her own words, and the rest of what was heard is shown in the sheet, where a tap removes something heard by mistake) and «Палітра» (opens a separate screen). A tap on a row opens its editor as a sheet with tiles and lists; after a manual edit the passport is rebuilt from the whole chat before building. Grey values are defaults: she has not chosen there. The card also has the question «Усе правильно?» («так» confirms, «поправити» returns to the field), the button «Зібрати образи» (it needs read colours, four girths and height, and an occasion or a description in her own words; the button says what is missing, and a hint with «До профілю» appears at the top of the screen) and «Зберегти сценарій» (into the library, with a name; an opened saved case can be updated with «Оновити» or saved with «Зберегти як новий»). When the stylist does not know something (for example, how formal), quick-answer beads from the reference tables appear above the field, and a tap sends the answer.
ITEM PHOTOS: next to «Надіслати», both in the letter sheet and in the chat field, there is a photo button — she can add one or several photos of an item (her own, or one she is thinking of buying) and ask whether it suits her and what to wear it with; a photo without words means exactly that question. The photo is shown as a thumbnail in her message; it stays on the phone with the case draft and is saved with the case in the library; a model receives it only within a call. The stylist names the item (what it is, colour, cut, length, fabric, whose it is), and the code measures its colour from the photo itself and decides whether the item suits her — it suits, it suits with a condition (for example, away from the face, with her neutral near the face), or another one would be better — and why; the stylist only retells this verdict. If she has not named an occasion, the item is judged for an ordinary day, and this is said. «Зібрати образи» puts the item from the photo into every outfit and picks the rest around it; on the card it stands with its photo and the mark «твоя річ» (or «річ з фото»), without a shop or price, and «Разом» does not count it. An item that does not suit her can still be built with — the card says in one line what softens it.
AN ITEM IN WORDS: she can also describe her own item without a photo; the stylist adds it to the case, and the code puts it into every outfit in the same way. Its colour then comes from her words, not from a measurement, and the card says so in the list of what the code does not know. Such a sentence, or a wish for an outfit with that item, written on any other screen, the code itself puts into the case chat and says it was added to the case; other questions outside the case do not go into building.
VOICE: next to the photo button there is a microphone — here in the chat and on the outfit card under the verdict field. The first tap starts recording and the second stops it; while she speaks, the text appears in the field at once and is appended to what is already written, so she can correct it by hand. It goes nowhere by itself: «Надіслати» sends the message, «Записати вердикт» records the verdict. The voice is recognised not by Lyusterko but by the browser's service (Google in Chrome, Apple on iPhone), and the sound goes to it; only the text it returns lands in the field. Where recognition is unavailable or the microphone is blocked, the button says so and suggests the microphone on the phone's keyboard, which types into the same field. The owner's report shows that a comment or a message was dictated.
At the top of the screen are «Збережені» (a list: a tap opens a case, «видалити» needs two taps) and «Новий» (a clean screen). An unsaved draft survives a page reload.

PALETTE — a separate screen, opened from the «Палітра» row of the card. It is computed from her colours, so it needs read colours; the colour maths starts here, and the first time it takes up to a minute. Gamut («приглушені», «середні», «насичені»), base — the main colour the outfit stands on («хай обере стилістка» lets the code pick; «радимо» marks the code's recommendation), and colour scheme — the branches legitimate for her colouring; without a choice the code takes the first. At the top is «← До сценарію».

BUILDING takes two to three minutes, longer the first time (an environment of about 15 MB loads). Without the access token (the owner's link ending with #token) neither the chat nor building works.
WAITING SCREEN: a loom weaving cloth in the colours of the chosen palette (the base as the thread, the accent as towel stripes) and four windows that clear up with the stages of building: the code gathers candidates, a model composes outfits, the code checks them, a model picks and describes them from photos of the chosen items. The chat field works here too.

OUTFITS (tab): four cards, one per screen, in random order. A card has a collage of item photos, the list of items with shop links and prices, «Разом», «Чому цей образ», «Як це носити» and «Приміряти на себе» (draws her in these items from her full-length photo; it costs a model call; a picture can also be added by hand). The verdict: «Вдягнеш?» («вдягну як є», «вдягну, якщо змінити одну річ», «не вдягну») → «Це саме твоє — чи просто гарний образ?» → the main part: a large field for her impressions in her own words, typed or dictated, under a question that follows her two answers (before them it reads «Що скажеш про цей образ?»; after them it asks what makes the outfit hers, what is missing for it to be hers, or what is in the way and what the outfit should have been) → optionally, below the field, one tap on short words, the same for every verdict («колір», «фасон», «поєднання», «стиль», «нагода», «погода», «зручність», «ціна», «не впевнена, що на мені так буде», «хочу спробувати», «справа у фото»): «Або коротко — що вдалось» after «as it is» with «hers» or no second answer, «Або коротко — що заважає» otherwise; and the mark «замінити» on the item that is wrong → «Записати вердикт». Above the cards: «Змінити сценарій» returns to the main screen, «Зібрати ще раз» gives four new outfits for the same case, «Усі образи ›» opens the library, and «Відкрити сценарій цього образу» restores the case the outfit was built from.
LIBRARY («Усі образи ›»): the built outfits grouped by case; a tap opens an outfit again, and judging it again adds a new record while the previous one stays. Below is the verdict log of this phone with «Скопіювати всі вердикти» to pass them to the owner. If there are latest outfits, «← Останні образи» is at the top.

On a laptop (a wide screen) the same four sections form a rail on the left together with «Новий сценарій», «Збережені» and the list of saved cases; the chat field sits under the chat and the case card to the right of it (on the profile, the photos are on the right). Edits are made in a sheet that rises from the bottom: it has «Готово», and a tap on the dimmed background closes it.

ONBOARDING — three steps, once, while there is no profile yet. Step 1 «Про тебе»: the portrait (as soon as it is added, the skin, hair and eye colours are read automatically; «Зчитати кольори з портрета» reads them again; «Інший шлях — через будь-який чат-помічник» lets her copy the request into any chat assistant and paste its answer back), a full-length photo (needed only to try an outfit on her), a name or pseudonym (the profile is called by it in the list of people and in the verdict record) and consent to record shades together with verdicts. Step 2 «Що тобі до лиця»: three pairs of fields next to her face — gold or silver, pure white or milky white, warm or cool neutrals («не бачу різниці» is a full answer) — and whether her own colouring is bright or muted. These answers narrow the temperature of the palette when the photo cannot establish it; the step can be skipped and done later. Step 3 «Фігура»: shoulders, bust, waist and hips in cm at the widest point over underwear, and height; the code derives the figure type from them. «Готово» creates the profile and opens the case screen.

PROFILE (tab) — rows, each showing what is already there: «Фото» (portrait and full length), «Твої кольори» (three swatches: skin, hair, eyes), «Ім'я» (and consent), «Що тобі до лиця» (her answers), «Обхвати і зріст» (four numbers and height), «Розширені виміри» (all optional: high hip, knee, calf and ankle refine the fit on the legs and hips; foot length in mm and head girth in cm check shoe and hat sizes), «Люди на цьому телефоні» («Чий це профіль» switches between people and «Новий профіль» adds one: several people can use one phone, each with her own data). A tap on a row opens its editor as a sheet with the same fields as in onboarding. What is still missing for building is labelled in gold.

CASE — the main screen; the one main thing on it is the chat. Before the chat starts, under the question «Куди ти збираєшся?» there is a letter sheet: she writes into it, as to a friend, where she is going, when, what the weather is, what she wants and does not want; below it are three example beads (a tap puts the example into the field without sending it) and «Або заповнити рукою» (shows an empty case card). From her words the stylist builds the case passport: event, occasion, place, formality, part of day, temperature, precipitation, requirements and limits. The messages form a thread, and under the last answer lies the case card with rows: «Нагода» («Спорт, активність», «Подорож», «Звичайний день», «Побачення», «Театр, концерт», «Робота», «Свято, вечірка»), «Де» («Вдома», «Надворі», «У дорозі», «Заклад», «Зал», «Офіс», «Урочистий зал»), «Ошатність» (the step of dress for this outing — home, everyday, neat, smart, strict, evening dress or ceremonial — set by whose standard holds there and the evening, not the event's name; a dress code chosen by hand overrides it), «Коли й погода» (part of day, temperature, «Без опадів», «Можливий дощ», «Дощ», «Сніг», wind, de-icing chemicals on the roads), «Макіяж» («Нюд, непомітний», «Помітний», «Яскравий, виразний»; for the last two also a lip colour — noticeable makeup gives the outfit one more step of contrast near the face, bold makeup already holds the focus on the face; «хай обере стилістка» hands this decision to the code on purpose; the lip colour is chosen from a ladder of shades split into those recommended for her and the rest, each with its reason, next to «свій відтінок» and «хай обере стилістка» for the colour itself), «Прикраси» («Золото», «Срібло», «Перли», «Етно: дерево, кістка, бісер», «Без прикрас» or «хай обере стилістка»: the code matches gold and silver against the metal of the items and removes the opposite metal from the pick, no jewellery removes jewellery altogether, and pearls cannot be told from ethnic pieces because shops do not say so — the code says this in its report), «Не хочу» («глибоке декольте», «відкрита спина», «відкриті руки», «відкриті плечі», «відкриті ноги», «відкритий живіт» — a hard limit, not a wish: the code removes such items from the pick itself; limits the stylist heard in her words go here too — items, fabrics, prints, colours: the card row names only what the code actually holds, which is colours and what she refused in her own words, and the rest of what was heard is shown in the sheet, where a tap removes something heard by mistake) and «Палітра» (opens a separate screen). A tap on a row opens its editor as a sheet with tiles and lists; after a manual edit the passport is rebuilt from the whole chat before building. Grey values are defaults: she has not chosen there. The card also has the question «Усе правильно?» («так» confirms, «поправити» returns to the field), the button «Зібрати образи» (it needs read colours, four girths and height, and an occasion or a description in her own words; the button says what is missing, and a hint with «До профілю» appears at the top of the screen) and «Зберегти сценарій» (into the library, with a name; an opened saved case can be updated with «Оновити» or saved with «Зберегти як новий»). When the stylist does not know something (for example, how formal), quick-answer beads from the reference tables appear above the field, and a tap sends the answer.
ITEM PHOTOS: next to «Надіслати», both in the letter sheet and in the chat field, there is a photo button — she can add one or several photos of an item (her own, or one she is thinking of buying) and ask whether it suits her and what to wear it with; a photo without words means exactly that question. The photo is shown as a thumbnail in her message; it stays on the phone with the case draft and is saved with the case in the library; a model receives it only within a call. The stylist names the item (what it is, colour, cut, length, fabric, whose it is), and the code measures its colour from the photo itself and decides whether the item suits her — it suits, it suits with a condition (for example, away from the face, with her neutral near the face), or another one would be better — and why; the stylist only retells this verdict. If she has not named an occasion, the item is judged for an ordinary day, and this is said. «Зібрати образи» puts the item from the photo into every outfit and picks the rest around it; on the card it stands with its photo and the mark «твоя річ» (or «річ з фото»), without a shop or price, and «Разом» does not count it. An item that does not suit her can still be built with — the card says in one line what softens it.
AN ITEM IN WORDS: she can also describe her own item without a photo; the stylist adds it to the case, and the code puts it into every outfit in the same way. Its colour then comes from her words, not from a measurement, and the card says so in the list of what the code does not know. Such a sentence, or a wish for an outfit with that item, written on any other screen, the code itself puts into the case chat and says it was added to the case; other questions outside the case do not go into building.
VOICE: next to the photo button there is a microphone — here in the chat and on the outfit card under the verdict field. The first tap starts recording and the second stops it; while she speaks, the text appears in the field at once and is appended to what is already written, so she can correct it by hand. It goes nowhere by itself: «Надіслати» sends the message, «Записати вердикт» records the verdict. The voice is recognised not by Lyusterko but by the browser's service (Google in Chrome, Apple on iPhone), and the sound goes to it; only the text it returns lands in the field. Where recognition is unavailable or the microphone is blocked, the button says so and suggests the microphone on the phone's keyboard, which types into the same field. The owner's report shows that a comment or a message was dictated.
At the top of the screen are «Збережені» (a list: a tap opens a case, «видалити» needs two taps) and «Новий» (a clean screen). An unsaved draft survives a page reload.

PALETTE — a separate screen, opened from the «Палітра» row of the card. It is computed from her colours, so it needs read colours; the colour maths starts here, and the first time it takes up to a minute. Gamut («приглушені», «середні», «насичені»), base — the main colour the outfit stands on («хай обере стилістка» lets the code pick; «радимо» marks the code's recommendation), and colour scheme — the branches legitimate for her colouring; without a choice the code takes the first. At the top is «← До сценарію».

BUILDING takes two to three minutes, longer the first time (an environment of about 15 MB loads). Without the access token (the owner's link ending with #token) neither the chat nor building works.
WAITING SCREEN: a loom weaving cloth in the colours of the chosen palette (the base as the thread, the accent as towel stripes) and four windows that clear up with the stages of building: the code gathers candidates, a model composes outfits, the code checks them, a model picks and describes them from photos of the chosen items. The chat field works here too.

OUTFITS (tab): four cards, one per screen, in random order. A card has a collage of item photos, the list of items with shop links and prices, «Разом», «Чому цей образ», «Як це носити» and «Приміряти на себе» (draws her in these items from her full-length photo; it costs a model call; a picture can also be added by hand). The verdict: «Вдягнеш?» («вдягну як є», «вдягну, якщо змінити одну річ», «не вдягну») → «Це саме твоє — чи просто гарний образ?» → the main part: a large field for her impressions in her own words, typed or dictated, under a question that follows her two answers (before them it reads «Що скажеш про цей образ?»; after them it asks what makes the outfit hers, what is missing for it to be hers, or what is in the way and what the outfit should have been) → optionally, below the field, one tap on short words, the same for every verdict («колір», «фасон», «поєднання», «стиль», «нагода», «погода», «зручність», «ціна», «не впевнена, що на мені так буде», «хочу спробувати», «справа у фото»): «Або коротко — що вдалось» after «as it is» with «hers» or no second answer, «Або коротко — що заважає» otherwise; and the mark «замінити» on the item that is wrong → «Записати вердикт». Above the cards: «Змінити сценарій» returns to the main screen, «Зібрати ще раз» gives four new outfits for the same case, «Усі образи ›» opens the library, and «Відкрити сценарій цього образу» restores the case the outfit was built from.
LIBRARY («Усі образи ›»): the built outfits grouped by case; a tap opens an outfit again, and judging it again adds a new record while the previous one stays. Below is the verdict log of this phone with «Скопіювати всі вердикти» to pass them to the owner. If there are latest outfits, «← Останні образи» is at the top.
